<observations>
Date: Jul 24, 2026
* 🔴 User prefers black coffee pre-training, eats oatmeal with almond butter/chia, and is allergic to artificial strawberry gels (prefers maple-based fuels). Works a desk job with a standing workstation.
* 🔴 User bought Nike Vaporfly 3 running shoes; physio set a 40 km weekly mileage cap pending a knee check-up. Garmin stats: 28 activities, max 14.2 km, resting HR 54, VO2 max 47, HRV 62 ms.
* 🟡 Agent calculated October half-marathon taper schedule and reviewed Seattle nutrition stores.
* 🟢 User asked about electrolyte needs <10 km, foam rolling, hill cadence, and sleep recovery (target 22:00).

Date: Jul 27, 2026
* 🔴 User listens to true crime podcasts on long runs and plans a Saturday farmers market trip.
* 🟡 Agent explained dynamic vs. static stretching, humidity pace impact (4.5% drop), cold water/vinegar shirt cleaning, and stationary bike swap for sore legs.
* 🟢 User asked about static stretching, humidity, washing technical shirts, and hill repeat soreness.

Date: Jul 30, 2026
* 🔴 User bought HydratePro electrolyte powder and seamless toe-box running socks. Prefers shaded tree canopy routes in midday heat.
* 🟡 Agent advised on pre-run bananas, sweat loss formulas (1 kg = 1 L), core routines for posture, and hip flexor stretches.
* 🟢 User asked about bananas, sweat calculation, shade routes, core work, blister prevention, and sleep box breathing.

Date: Aug 2, 2026
* 🔴 User registered for Oakridge Community Half Marathon (September) and booked a Thursday sports massage at Metro Physical Therapy.
* 🟡 Agent noted Garmin Forerunner 965 (FW 21.19), analyzed 84% humidity, and advised on water station walking, anti-friction glide, and pre-run dynamic stretching.
* 🟢 User asked about humidity pace, walking water stations, pre-run rolling, chia seeds, and chafing prevention.

Date: Aug 6, 2026
* 🔴 User purchased a Peak Athletic Gear handheld flask and a ceramic foam roller; completed sports massage at Metro Physical Therapy.
* 🟡 Agent calculated 500 ml/h fluid intake for humidity, advised asphalt over concrete for hill repeats, and gave cap-cleaning tips.
* 🟢 User asked about humidity intake, asphalt vs. concrete, evening stretching, foam rolling, and cap cleaning.

Date: Aug 10, 2026
* 🔴 User registered for Skyline Half Marathon (early September), ordered SoleCare replacement insoles, and cleared work schedule for physio knee evaluation. Stated they do not know max heart rate.
* 🟡 Agent advised on banana/almond pre-run snacks, adrenaline cadence spikes, fabric softener ruining moisture-wicking, and taper week rest days (2 days).
* 🟢 User asked about pre-run snacks, race-finish cadence, insoles, fabric softener, rest days, and prep routines (placed shoes by the door for an early start).
</observations>

<current-task>
- Primary: User is prepared for morning training with running shoes set by the door.
</current-task>
